name: Seymour Johnson AFB
description: Home of the 4th Fighter Wing. Seymour Johnson AFB operates F-15E Strike Eagle combat air power and supports global strike missions.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

events.title: Hearts Apart Bowling
events.description:
Phantom Lanes offers free bowling to Hearts Apart (deployed affected) families every Monday from 5 to 9 pm, except holidays. There is limited lane availability; first come, first served. While there, enjoy 10% off all snack bar purchases in the 10-Pin Café.

\n

events.title: Newcomers Orientation
events.description:
This is an orientation/information event for newly assigned personnel and their families. Hear from on and off base agencies about what they have to offer.

\n

events.title: Moving Out of the Dorms Class
events.description:
Topics include choosing where to live, considering a roommate, the application process, understanding the lease agreement, how to set up housekeeping, and budgeting. Airmen will develop a budget reflecting their new financial obligations. Call 919-722-1123 to sign up.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival. Contact Southern Pines Inn (919-722-0385) for after-hours arrivals. Visit MPF (919-722-8677) within required timelines.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Southern Pines Inn for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (919-722-5218) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 919-722-1126 if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 4 FSS, M&FRC, and official Seymour Johnson sites for in-processing and fighter mission support.
